quote: If a highway has two or more clearly marked lanes for traffic traveling in one direction, vehicles must: Not be moved from that lane until the driver has given the appropriate turn signal and ascertained that such movement can be made with safety.

activation.description: A highway has at least two clearly marked lanes for traffic traveling in one direction, and the subject moves from its occupied lane.
activation.source_clause: If a highway has two or more clearly marked lanes for traffic traveling in one direction

obligation.description: Do not move from the occupied lane until both a prior appropriate turn signal and safety ascertainment are present.
obligation.source_clause: Not be moved from that lane until the driver has given the appropriate turn signal and ascertained that such movement can be made with safety.

timing.description: Observe indicator onset and separate check before first full-body departure from occupied lane.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: ascertained that such movement can be made with safety
judgment_calls_needed.note: Separate controller check and target-lane actor gaps are retained; human ascertainment and legal safety remain unresolved.
